title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the current school year on Monday. School officials placed the campus on lockdown out of an abundance of caution, and the school later returned to normal operations. The latest threat used a masked phone number, which matches a pattern seen in the earlier incidents this year.

In a letter to parents, Gwinnett County Public Schools police said they are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. No arrests have been announced so far and no suspect has been identified. The investigation remains active as authorities continue to look for the source of the calls.
